data.name: Payments_NoPermission
data.value: You do not have permission to manage payments.

data.name: Payments_ModuleDisabled
data.value: Receiving payments is currently switched off for this installation.

data.name: Payments_LinkExpired
data.value: The setup link had expired. Start it again to continue where you left off.

data.name: Payments_Stage_None_Body
data.value: Payments from your customers go to an account of your own, not through this platform. You will be asked for your company details and a bank account, and you have to identify yourself — that is a legal requirement for receiving money, not a formality of ours.

data.name: Payments_Stage_None_Duration
data.value: The form takes a few minutes. The review usually finishes within a day; until then you can already see the account here.

data.name: Payments_Field_CountryHint
data.value: The country of your company. It CANNOT be changed later — a wrong country means starting over with a new account.

data.name: Payments_Stage_Incomplete_Body
data.value: You started the setup but have not submitted all details yet. Nothing is lost — continue where you stopped.

data.name: Payments_Stage_Review_Body
data.value: Everything has been handed in and is being checked. You do not have to do anything; this page updates once the account is cleared.

data.name: Payments_PayoutsPending
data.value: You can already take payments. Payouts to your bank account start once the last checks are done.

data.name: Payments_Deadline
data.value: Please supply the missing details by {0}.

data.name: Payments_Stage_Disconnected_Title
data.value: The connection to your payout account was severed

data.name: Payments_Stage_Disconnected_Body
data.value: This application can no longer reach your account, so no further sales are possible. Setting it up again creates a new payout account; sales already made keep pointing at the old one.

data.name: Payments_PendingVerification
data.value: {0} document(s) submitted and still under review.

data.name: Payments_NoDashboard
data.value: This account type has its own login; there is no direct link from here.

data.name: Payments_Error_NotPermitted
data.value: You are not permitted to do this.

data.name: Payments_Error_Disabled
data.value: Receiving payments is switched off for this installation.

data.name: Payments_Error_FeatureMissing
data.value: Receiving payments is not part of your current subscription.

data.name: Payments_Error_NoAccount
data.value: There is no payout account yet. Set one up first.

data.name: Payments_Error_ChargesDisabled
data.value: Your payout account cannot accept payments at the moment. Check the outstanding details on this page.

data.name: Payments_Error_PayoutsDisabled
data.value: Your payout account has no payout route yet, and this installation requires one before you can sell.

data.name: Payments_Error_Disconnected
data.value: The connection to your payout account was severed. Set up a new one.

data.name: Payments_Error_InvalidAmount
data.value: The sale needs a positive amount, a currency and a reference.

data.name: Payments_Error_SaleNotRefundable
data.value: This sale was never paid, so there is nothing to refund.

data.name: Payments_Error_RefundExceedsAmount
data.value: The amount is more than what is left of this sale.

data.name: Payments_Error_MissingCharge
data.value: This sale has no payment on record, so a refund cannot be addressed.

data.name: Payments_Error_ProviderError
data.value: The payment provider refused the request. The details are in the system log.

data.name: Payments_Error_UnsupportedChargeType
data.value: The configured payment flow is not supported by this installation.

data.name: Refund_Intro
data.value: Sale {0}. At most {1} can still be refunded.

data.name: Refund_FeeKeptWarning
data.value: Without this, the commission stays with the platform: you refund the customer in full and still pay for the reversed sale.

data.name: Waiver_Progress
data.value: Turnover this period: {0} of {1} — {2} to go until the base fee is waived next month.

data.name: Waiver_Reached
data.value: Turnover this period: {0} of {1} — reached. Next month's base fee is on us.

data.name: Waiver_Explanation
data.value: The waiver is earned in the period that has just ended and applied to the following invoice, because subscription invoices are raised in advance. The first month can therefore never be waived.

data.name: Admin_None
data.value: No payout account has been set up yet.

data.name: Terminals_Intro
data.value: Card terminals at your checkouts. Each device is reached either directly through its provider or through the agent on the checkout PC.

data.name: Terminals_None
data.value: No terminal has been set up yet.

data.name: Terminals_NoDeleteHint
data.value: Terminals cannot be deleted: past sales keep referring to the device they were taken on. Disable a terminal you no longer use.

data.name: Terminals_Field_DisplayNameHint
data.value: How the terminal appears at the checkout, e.g. "Counter 1".

data.name: Terminals_Field_ProviderTerminalIdHint
data.value: The identifier the provider uses for this device; you find it in the provider's dashboard or on the device.

data.name: Terminals_NoServerSettings
data.value: This provider needs no further settings.

data.name: Terminals_NoDeviceSettings
data.value: This device needs no further settings.

data.name: Terminals_DeviceUnreachable
data.value: The checkout could not be reached ({0}). The terminal can still be saved; its device settings can only be made once the checkout is reachable again.

data.name: Terminals_RequiredMissing
data.value: Please fill in all required fields.

data.name: Payments_Error_OwnAccessUnavailable
data.value: Your own account at this provider cannot be used right now. Check it under "Own provider accounts" and renew the key if necessary.

data.name: Payments_Error_InvalidSettings
data.value: Some details are missing or do not fit.

data.name: OwnAccess_Intro
data.value: If you already have an account with wallee, Payrexx or SumUp, connect it here. Online payments and terminals of that provider then run over your own account.

data.name: OwnAccess_NotAvailable
data.value: No provider that supports own accounts is set up in this installation.

data.name: OwnAccess_None
data.value: No own account is connected yet. Payments run over the platform account.

data.name: OwnAccess_RenewIntro
data.value: Enter the new key of the SAME account. To connect a different account, use "Connect account" instead - the sales of the old account stay refundable over it.

data.name: OwnAccess_SetUpWebhooks
data.value: Set up notifications in the account

data.name: OwnAccess_NoDeleteHint
data.value: Accounts are disabled, not deleted: the sales paid on them are refunded over them.

data.name: OwnAccess_Field_DisplayNameHint
data.value: How you recognise this account, e.g. "Payrexx shop Bern".

data.name: Terminals_Field_PairingCodeHint
data.value: On the device: Connections → API → Connect. The code shown there is valid for five minutes.
